title: Trilogy Excursions

services.name: Lanai Snorkel
services.desc: Your tour starts with a continental breakfast of Mom Coon’s 4th generation cinnamon rolls and chilled tropical fruit cup, complimented with Kona coffee, hot tea, hot cocoa, POG or pineapple juice. For lunch*, enjoy our savory shoyu chicken, spring mix salad with Mom Coon’s famous dressing, rice and soft Hawaiian sweet rolls. Lunch is always served-no buffet lines or paper plates and plastic silverware aboard our first-class boats! Our return sail includes a premium bar for guests 21+ with ID (Beer, Wine, Cocktails), as well as soda, juice, and chilled filtered water.
